intel.title: [CISA KEV] Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) - Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2024-10441
廠商: Synology
產品: DiskStation Manager (DSM)
漏洞名稱: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
說明: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) 存在未適當轉義/編碼之安全漏洞（CVE-2024-10441），遠端攻擊者可藉此執行任意程式碼（RCE）。該漏洞已列入 CISA KEV 且在真實環境中遭活躍利用，具極高風險。由於公司資產中包含多台正在使用中的 Synology NAS 設備，需立即進行修補。
analysis.recommendation: 請立即參照 Synology 官方資安公告（Synology_SA_24_20），將公司內所有 Synology NAS 設備之 DSM 系統升級至最新安全補丁版本。若暫時無法立即完成更新，應限制 NAS 設備的網際網路連線與存取權限，以降低遭遠端攻擊的風險。
affected_assets: 資訊設備-NAS-Synology RS1221RP+|資訊設備-NAS-Synology DS218+|資訊設備-NAS-Synology DS216j

intel.title: [CISA KEV] BerriAI LiteLLM - BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-40217
廠商: BerriAI
產品: LiteLLM
漏洞名稱: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
說明: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-12-02
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM 被揭露存在未受保護替代通道漏洞（CVE-2026-40217），並已列入 CISA KEV 活躍攻擊清單。遠端攻擊者可透過 /guardrails/test_custom_code 端點進行位元組碼重寫，進而執行任意程式碼（RCE）。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) - Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-90817
廠商: Vanderbilt University
產品: Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)
漏洞名稱: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
說明: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Vanderbilt University 所開發的 REDCap 系統存在代碼注入漏洞（CVE-2026-90817），未授權的攻擊者可利用公開問卷情境傳遞特製參數，在伺服器上執行任意程式碼。該漏洞已遭實際利用並被 CISA 列入 KEV 清單，要求受影響單位限期修補。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Apache Axis - Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-90436
廠商: Apache
產品: Axis
漏洞名稱: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
說明: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: ; https://lists.apache.org/thread/8slf0j9gz35z56t0glt5h0ncwlbn4bdz ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-90436

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 已將 Apache Axis 的不安全反射漏洞（CVE-2026-90436）列入已知受利用漏洞名單。未經身分驗證的遠端攻擊者可透過傳送精心設計的 SOAP 錯誤訊息觸發反射機制，於伺服器上執行任意程式碼（RCE）。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
